articles.title: Pakistan Faces Big Embarrassment At Asian Para Games 2026
articles.description: India produced a historic performance at the 2026 Asian Para Games, finishing with a record 114 medals, including 30 gold. The achievement marked the country's best-ever medal haul at the continental para-sports event. Several Indian athletes delivered outstanding performances, with Sheetal Devi, Nishad Kumar and Simran Sharma among those who won multiple gold medals. India celebrated a memorable campaign, but neighbouring Pakistan endured a disappointing outing in Japan. The Pakistani contingent managed to secure just one medal, with athletics providing its only podium finish. Here's a closer look at Pakistan's performance and India's remarkable progress at the Asian Para Games. Pakistan Returns With Just One Medal Pakistan struggled to make an impact at the 2026 Asian Para Games, finishing its campaign with only one medal. Haider Ali was the country's sole medallist, winning silver in the men's discus throw F37 event. Pakistan sent nine athletes to Japan to compete across four sports. However, Ali was the only competitor from the contingent to secure a podium finish, leaving the country with a solitary silver medal. The campaign also marked a setback in terms of gold medals. Pakistan failed to win a gold for the first time since the 2014 edition. At the 2022 Asian Para Games, the country had secured one gold medal, but it could not repeat that achievement in 2026. India Continues Its Rise At Asian Para Games India's medal tally has grown significantly across successive editions of the Asian Para Games. From winning just 14 medals in 2010, the country has steadily strengthened its position in para-sports. India's progress across the editions is reflected in its overall medal count: - 2010: 14 medals - 2014: 33 medals - 2018: 72 medals, including 15 gold - 2022: 108 medals, including 27 gold - 2026: 114 medals, including 30 gold India crossed the 100-medal mark for the first time in 2022, finishing with 108 medals. The contingent improved on that achievement in 2026, adding six more medals to establish a new national record at the Games. The latest campaign also featured several standout individual performances. Six Indian athletes, including Sheetal Devi, Nishad Kumar and Simran Sharma, won two gold medals each, while four other Indian athletes secured three medals apiece.

articles.title: Naman Dhir's Entry Closes Team India Doors For These 3 Players
articles.description: Team India may have discovered a new finishing option in Naman Dhir, whose explosive batting has made an immediate impact in the T20I series against New Zealand. The young batter delivered crucial contributions in the first two matches, strengthening his case for a bigger role in India's T20 setup. His performances could increase the competition for places currently occupied by Rinku Singh, Washington Sundar and Shivam Dube. In the opening T20I in Christchurch on October 22, India faced a challenging target of 226 runs. With the chase entering a crucial phase, Dhir produced a blistering unbeaten 42 off just 15 deliveries, striking five fours and two sixes. His late assault helped India reach 230/6 in 19.4 overs and secure a four-wicket victory. Dhir continued to impress in the second T20I on October 24. With India under pressure, he contributed 31 runs off 17 balls, once again demonstrating his ability to score quickly when the team needs momentum. His performances have strengthened his case for consideration as a finisher. However, consistent performances over a longer period will be important before his place in the squad can be considered secure. Naman Dhir's T20I Numbers Dhir has played six T20 Internationals, scoring 80 runs in five innings at a reported strike rate of 285.71. His highest score is an unbeaten 42, and he has hit seven fours and six sixes. He has also taken three wickets in the format, offering an additional bowling option. 1. Rinku Singh Rinku Singh has established himself as a powerful finisher for India, particularly through his ability to accelerate in the closing overs and handle pressure. However, Dhir's recent performances provide the team management with another aggressive batting option. If Dhir continues to deliver in difficult situations, the competition for a place in the lower middle order could become tougher. Rinku's experience and finishing ability, though, remain important factors in selection decisions. 2. Washington Sundar Washington Sundar offers value through his all-round abilities, contributing with both bat and ball. His bowling can provide balance to the team, while his batting gives India flexibility in the middle order. Dhir's emergence could intensify the competition for a spot, depending on the team's combination. However, the two players fulfil different roles, and Sundar's bowling skills could remain a key advantage in selection. 3. Shivam Dube Shivam Dube is known for his power-hitting, particularly against spin, and can change the course of a match with his ability to clear the boundary. He also offers a different batting profile from Dhir. The young batter's recent displays could create a selection dilemma if India want to accommodate multiple power-hitters. Ultimately, the choice will depend on the opposition, match conditions and the balance required in the playing XI. Rather than automatically closing the door on Rinku Singh, Washington Sundar or Shivam Dube, Dhir's emergence is likely to make competition for places more intense. The team management will have to weigh recent form against experience, bowling contributions and the specific requirements of each match.

articles.title: MS Dhoni Retiring Before IPL 2027? Thala Breaks Silence
articles.description: MS Dhoni's participation in IPL 2027 remains uncertain, with the Chennai Super Kings legend yet to make a final decision about his future. The former CSK captain has said he will decide whether he can continue playing another season before December, depending on his medical reports and fitness. Dhoni missed the entire previous season due to a calf injury, leading to widespread speculation about his possible retirement from the Indian Premier League. However, the wicketkeeper-batter has not ruled out a return and is waiting for medical assessments before making a final call. MS Dhoni Reveals Timeline For IPL 2027 Decision Dhoni recently travelled to Bengaluru to attend a healthcare event, where he was asked about his plans for the upcoming IPL season. According to news agency ANI, he explained that he first needs to undergo medical check-ups and receive the doctors' reports before deciding whether he is fit enough to play. "I need to get some check-ups done, the doctors need to provide me with the reports, and before December, I have to decide whether or not I am in a position to play another season," Dhoni said. His statement indicates that his participation in IPL 2027 will depend largely on his physical condition and the medical advice he receives. Dhoni Leaves Fitness Decision To Doctors Speaking about his fitness, Dhoni used a light-hearted comparison to describe his situation, suggesting that the responsibility now lies with the doctors to determine whether his body can handle another demanding IPL season. "You (the doctors) have to ensure that everything is fine with me - that an 'old vehicle' like me can still run properly on the road. So, the pressure is on the doctors," he said. Meanwhile, Chennai Super Kings have appointed Zaheer Khan as their head coach ahead of the next season. Reports have suggested that Dhoni played an important role in the appointment. Even if he does not return as a player, his experience could remain valuable to CSK's auction preparations and broader team planning. CSK Await Dhoni's Decision Ahead Of Retention Deadline IPL 2027 retention deadline for all franchises is November 15. CSK will therefore need to assess its squad plans while keeping Dhoni's availability in mind. Chennai Super Kings CEO Kasi Viswanathan has reportedly confirmed that the decision to play another season rests entirely with Dhoni. The franchise has not ruled out the possibility of his return. For now, fans will have to wait for Dhoni's medical reports and his final decision before knowing whether the CSK icon will take the field in IPL 2027.
